notes.title: Version 1.008 is out now!
notes.notes:
Version 1.008 is out!

- Made some adjustments for the rookie and professional difficulties to make them easier. 
Veteran difficulty is still as hard as ever though!

- Adjusted the "Pacifist" achievement to make it easier to obtain.

notes.title: Update no. 3
notes.notes:
Version 1.006 is here!

Here´s whats new:

- Revamped the power up drop functionality to make it feel less random and more fair
- Added sounds for the electric floors on level 3 to give the player a heads up for when to avoid them
- Slightly changed the positions of some enemies
- Slightly adjusted two achievements to make them easier to get

notes.title: Update no. 1
notes.notes:
General updates

- Reduced knockback by 1/3
- Reduced bullet delay by 1/2 on Scattershot, Phaseshot and Ricochet
- Fixed an issue with saving/loading in New game+
- Found a game crashing bug and fixed it
- Shortened the intro/space stage


Boss 4 (Traahg queen) updates

- Lowered HP of boss 4 on Rookie difficulty
- Increased the spacing between falling roof pieces
- Decreased falling speed of roof pieces
- Increased time window to shoot at boss 4
